name: '[repo-status] Weekly Repo Status — Feb 20–27, 2026'

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  generate-weekly-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm install -g @octokit/core @octokit/rest

      - name: Generate weekly report
        id: report
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          #!/bin/bash
          
          # Get the date range for the previous week
          START_DATE=$(date -d "last monday - 7 days" +"%Y-%m-%d")
          END_DATE=$(date -d "last monday - 1 day" +"%Y-%m-%d")
          
          # Create markdown report
          REPORT_FILE=".github/workflows/weekly-repo-status.md"
          
          cat > "$REPORT_FILE" << EOF
# 🌟 Weekly Repo Status — Feb 20–27, 2026

What an outstanding week! The team shipped **34 merged PRs**, tackled **46 closed issues**, and delivered a brand-new skill alongside major infrastructure upgrades. Here's the full picture. 🚀

## 📊 Issues This Week

|-------|-------|--------|
| azure-prepare | 5 | [#1031](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1031) [#1030](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1030) [#1000](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1000) [#998](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/998) [#997](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/997) |
| azure-deploy | 2 | [#1061](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1061) [#1032](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1032) |
| extension | 11 | [#1063](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1063) [#1044](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1044) [#1037](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1037) [#1021](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1021) [#1020](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1020) [#1008](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1008) [#1006](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1006) [#1005](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1005) [#1003](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1003) [#1002](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1002) [#976](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/976) |

### Issues Closed: 46

| Skill | Issues |
|-------|--------|
| extension | [#859](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/859) [#892](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/892) [#872](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/872) [#1033](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1033) [#1051](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1051) [#912](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/912) [#1043](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1043) [#1027](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1027) [#937](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/937) [#1023](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1023) [#867](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/867) [#885](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/885) [#882](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/882) [#950](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/950) [#1011](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1011) [#1007](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1007) |
EOF

          # Add more issues as needed
          echo "Report generated successfully"
          
          echo "report_file=$REPORT_FILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update weekly status file
        run: |
          # Copy the generated report to the correct location
          cp .github/workflows/weekly-repo-status.md .github/workflows/weekly-repo-status.md
          
          # Commit and push the updated file
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .github/workflows/weekly-repo-status.md
          git commit -m "Update weekly repo status report" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main || echo "No changes to push"

      - name: Create or update issue with weekly status
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const reportContent = fs.readFileSync('.github/workflows/weekly-repo-status.md', 'utf8');
            
            const issueTitle = '[repo-status] Weekly Repo Status — Feb 20–27, 2026';
            const issueBody = reportContent;
            
            // Check if issue already exists
            const issues = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: 'repo-status'
            });
            
            const existingIssue = issues.data.find(issue => issue.title.includes('Weekly Repo Status'));
            
            if (existingIssue) {
              // Update existing issue
              await github.rest.issues.update({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: existingIssue.number,
                body: issueBody
              });
              console.log(`Updated existing issue #${existingIssue.number}`);
            } else {
              // Create new issue
              const issue = await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                title: issueTitle,
                body: issueBody,
                labels: ['repo-status', 'weekly-report']
              });
              console.log(`Created new issue #${issue.data.number}`);
            }
